enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn on back. Sleep. Move arms. Sleep.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Exit.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Pour eggs. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Toast bread. Spread butter. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up dishes. Exit kitchen.

Pick up bag. Walk to door. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Greet colleagues. Put on uniform. Wash hands. Check patient list. Review patient charts. Visit patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Check temperature. Administer medication. Update patient records. Talk to patient. Answer questions. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure.
Go to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink beverage. Talk with colleagues. Check phone. Finish eating. Return tray. Leave cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Return to work area. Wash hands. Check patient list. Visit patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Update patient records. Talk to patient. Answer questions. Consult with doctor. Assist with procedure. Attend meeting. Write reports. Wash hands. Leave work area.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat, sauce. Prepare vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Add meat. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, using computer, staying cool with air conditioning
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch TV. Eat snack. Watch TV. Use computer. Turn off TV. Turn off laptop. Turn off air conditioner. Exit living room.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch. Sleep. Turn to other side. Sleep.
